autotile.pattern: 16-tile Wang corner autotile (create_topdown_tileset, mode=standard), corners encoded NE/NW/SE/SW as lower (water) or upper (grass)
autotile.metadata: tiles/water_grass_tileset_metadata.json -- per-tile id, corners and bounding_box (x,y,32,32) as returned by PixelLab get_topdown_tileset
autotile.note: 16-tile Wang only (same tier as the forest-v6 water_blob), not the Wang-47 the v4.1 path/denseedge sets use -- two-edge-without-diagonal corners can still show the same seam Wang-47 fixes. Not tested on a real map.

tiles.collisionNote: Water itself has no shape-based collision here -- game-dev marks collision per-cell if needed, independent of the art (briefing/12_map_factory_v2.md).
